notes: The fused לֹא מִשְׁפָּט → *injustice* unit was headed on מִשְׁפָּט because that noun's lexeme is written inside the English word. Rule 23 forbids choosing a source head by the English word written, rules that a negation heads the unit it is fused into, and sends a tie between two morphemes whose senses are both written to the one standing first and governing the rest; rule 35 heads a fused *no* or *Nor* on the negative for the same reason. All three put the head on לֹא. The chapter's other rule 30 fusion, צוּף־דְּבַשׁ → *honeycomb* at 16.24, already heads on the first and governing morpheme, so this unit was the outlier. Source head only; every edge is unchanged.
